proposal: Separate advisory shadow SQLite storage; retain the authoritative health database and independent collector.
validation: Serial existing Node regression checks, excluding the already-preserved legacy latency gate. Python, build, types, Edge and self-checks begin after Node completion. No benchmark reruns to replace failures.
interpretation: The isolated legacy gate is not equivalent to the independent-writer Phase 8-D comparison. Existing measurements support a shared-lock risk, not a measured speedup for an unimplemented alternative.
